title: SitusAMC Foreclosure Suit Over $240M Loan Tied to 181 West Madison (Chicago Loop Office Tower)
jurisdiction: U.S. District Court, Northern District of Illinois (Eastern Division)
amount: $240 million loan; foreclosure suit seeks approximately $223 million in outstanding principal and interest
summary: Special servicer SitusAMC filed a foreclosure suit against the borrower entity behind 181 West Madison Street, a 50-story Chicago Loop office tower, over a $240 million loan, coupling the complaint with a motion to appoint Hilco Real Estate's Matthew Mason as receiver. The borrower is wholly owned by Bermuda-based SinOceanic I Limited, which took ownership in 2023 out of prior landlord HNA Group's bankruptcy; the default follows a downsized lease renewal by anchor tenant Northern Trust and reports of unpaid utility bills and vendors.
significance: Illustrates how quickly a single anchor tenant's downsized renewal can push a stabilized-looking office asset into default, and how special servicers are now bundling receivership requests directly into foreclosure complaints to secure operational control of distressed towers well before any final judgment.
